doc: One parse, one buffer: the tree, its tokens, and what was asked for.

fields.name: magic
fields.doc: `ONWR`, little-endian.

fields.name: version
fields.doc: FORMAT_VERSION. A reader that does not know it refuses the dish.

fields.name: sectionCount
fields.doc: Directory entries: one per SECTIONS row, always all of them.

fields.name: flags
fields.doc: Bit 0: every offset is a UTF-16 code unit rather than a byte.

fields.name: usfmVersion
fields.doc: The `\usfm` line's version as a ladder index (0 = 3.0), or NONE.

fields.name: sourceLength
fields.doc: The source's length, in the dish's own offset space.

fields.name: sourceHash
fields.doc: xxh3-64 of the source BYTES, whichever space the dish was plated in.

envelope.doc: Byte offset and length of each section, in SECTIONS order.

fields.name: offset
fields.doc: Where the section starts; every section is 4-aligned.

fields.name: length
fields.doc: Its bytes, before the padding to the next 4-byte boundary.

envelope.doc: The scanner's output, in document order.
The tree's nodes. Node id is the row index.
The shared child arena: token ids, and node ids tagged with bit 31.
Findings, sorted by anchor then code. Empty unless asked for.
Offered repairs, reached through a diagnostic's `fix`.
The shared edit arena every fix's range indexes.
Inserted bytes, concatenated. Edits carry absolute positions into it.
The chapter table. Empty unless asked for.
The verse anchors. Empty unless asked for.
What every verse designator covers, run after run; a verse's `membersFrom`/`membersLen` name its run. Empty unless asked for.

records.name: Token
records.doc: One lexical token: the leaves of the tree.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: Where the token begins.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: Where it ends. Spans TILE the document, so ends ascend too.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: Packed TokenKind; bit 4 is the per-shape spelling bit.

fields.name: marker
fields.doc: Row in the marker table; 0 is UNRESOLVED.

fields.name: level
fields.doc: The trailing number as spelled: 2 for `\q2`, 1 for `\tc1`, 0 for a bare `\q`. The row's `numbering` says whether it is a nesting level or a column index.

fields.name: flags
fields.doc: `TOKEN_DELIMITER_FOLDED` | `TOKEN_BLANK`. Also rounds the row to 12 bytes, so every row's `start` and `end` land aligned for a typed-array view over a 4-aligned section.

records.name: Node
records.doc: One structural node. `token` and the child range are indices, not offsets.

fields.name: token
fields.doc: The opening marker's token index; u32::MAX on the root.

fields.name: childFrom
fields.doc: Start of this node's range in the child arena.

fields.name: childTo
fields.doc: End of that range. Ranges are neither contiguous nor monotonic.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: CloseReason: Explicit, Implicit, Recovery, Eof.

fields.name: ctx
fields.doc: The stamped SpecContext.

records.name: Diagnostic
records.doc: One finding, with its anchor resolved from a token index to a span.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Index into the lint catalog.

fields.name: from
fields.doc: The anchor's start.

fields.name: to
fields.doc: The anchor's end.

fields.name: secondFrom
fields.doc: The other party's start, or NONE.

fields.name: secondTo
fields.doc: The other party's end, or NONE.

fields.name: aux
fields.doc: The code's aux integer; its meaning is the catalog row's.

fields.name: fix
fields.doc: Index into the fix section, or NONE.

fields.name: reserved
fields.doc: Rounds the row to 32 bytes. Room for a u64 code or a checksum.

records.name: Fix
records.doc: One offered repair: the edits it owns.

fields.name: editFrom
fields.doc: Start of this fix's range in the edit section.

fields.name: editTo
fields.doc: End of that range.

records.name: Edit
records.doc: One edit of a repair: replace [from, to) with the named text.

fields.name: from
fields.doc: Where the replacement starts.

fields.name: to
fields.doc: Where it ends; equal to `from` for a pure insertion.

fields.name: textFrom
fields.doc: Start of the inserted bytes in the fix-text section.

fields.name: textLen
fields.doc: Their length. Zero is a pure deletion.

records.name: Chapter
records.doc: One chapter's extent and number. The rows tile the document.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: Where the chapter begins.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: Where it ends.

fields.name: token
fields.doc: The `\c` marker's token index; NONE on the front-matter row.

fields.name: designator
fields.doc: The number's own token index, or NONE. `\c` opens no node, so this is the only route from a chapter to its designator.

fields.name: labelStart
fields.doc: The designator as written (`12b`), minus its folded delimiter. Empty at the marker's end when there is none; 0..0 on row 0.

fields.name: labelEnd
fields.doc: Where the label ends.

fields.name: number
fields.doc: The number read, or 0 for absent or malformed.

records.name: Verse
records.doc: One verse anchor and the range of verse numbers it names.

fields.name: at
fields.doc: Where the anchor sits.

fields.name: token
fields.doc: The `\v` marker's token index.

fields.name: designator
fields.doc: The number's own token index, or NONE. `\v` opens no node, so this is the only route from a verse to its designator.

fields.name: labelStart
fields.doc: The designator as written (`6a`, `1,3,5`), minus its folded delimiter. Empty at the marker's end when there is none.

fields.name: labelEnd
fields.doc: Where the label ends.

fields.name: membersFrom
fields.doc: This verse's first row in the member arena.

fields.name: membersLen
fields.doc: How many members it covers; 0 when the designator is absent or malformed.

fields.name: chapter
fields.doc: The enclosing chapter's number.

fields.name: first
fields.doc: First verse named; 0 when the designator is absent or malformed.

fields.name: last
fields.doc: Last verse named — a bridge `\v 5-7` names 5 through 7.

records.name: Member
records.doc: One member of a verse designator: a place, or a range joined by `-`. `first..last` on the verse is only the hull; these are what it covers.

fields.name: from
fields.doc: The member's first number.

fields.name: fromSegmentStart
fields.doc: The segment written after it (`a` in `12a`); empty when none.

fields.name: fromSegmentEnd
fields.doc: Where that segment ends.

fields.name: to
fields.doc: Its last number; equal to `from` for a single place. Kept as written.

fields.name: toSegmentStart
fields.doc: The segment after the last number; empty when none.

fields.name: toSegmentEnd
fields.doc: Where that segment ends.
